verdicts.evidence: schema/exemptions.schema.json:61-62 keeps minLength:24 but the description now reads 'a loose floor here on purpose: the schema refuses only a reason that is no reason at all, and CFG.EXEMPTIONS checks the real bound of 40 characters per entry. Raising this one crashes Ledger.read, and with it sync, every scan and the docs build...' replacing the false '≥ 40 chars on scope finding' claim the finding quoted. git log shows the fix pass first raised minLength to 40, then the audit-changes round reverted it to 24 because Ledger.read throws on any schema failure and is called by sync/every scan/the doctor/the docs build, so a 40-char floor there would crash the tool over a short ledger sentence — with the real 40-char bound left to Doctor.jl:308 (`length(e["reason"]) >= 40`), which names the offender instead of crashing. This matches the owner ruling on record that the schema floor and the doctor's floor are deliberately different instruments, not a gap to close. The finding's actual defect — a description that misstates which entries the 40-char bound applies to — is corrected; the numeric divergence is now accurately documented rather than silently wrong.
